step1_analysis.circuit_type: Burst-Mode Receiver Buffer / Voltage Follower with Reset
step1_analysis.description: A fast voltage buffer utilizing a differential amplifier with an active load in unity-gain feedback, followed by a source follower. It includes a reset transistor to quickly discharge the internal node and output, which is essential for fast recovery in burst-mode optical receivers.

paper_reference.title: A Burst-Mode Receiver for 1.25-Gb/s Ethernet PON With AGC and Internally Created Reset Signal

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the buffer

sky130_expected.calculation: The circuit is in a unity-gain feedback configuration (N1 tracks IN, OUT replicates N1). Gain = 20*log10(Vout/Vin) ≈ 0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Feedback forces the source follower output to track the input closely, resulting in near 0 dB gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the transconductance of the diff pair and the parasitic capacitance at node N0/N4. f_3dB ≈ gm / (2 * pi * C_node).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to match the 1 GHz operating frequency reported in the paper for 1.25-Gb/s operation.

delay_rise.description: Propagation delay from input to output during a rising edge

sky130_expected.calculation: Buffer delay is minimal, dominated by the RC time constant of the internal nodes.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A single-stage buffer in 130nm should have sub-nanosecond delay.

reset_time.description: Time required to discharge the output when RESET is asserted

sky130_expected.calculation: Discharge time depends on the ON-resistance of XM6 and the load capacitance. t = R_on * C_load.
sky130_expected.reasoning: XM6 is a strong pull-down NMOS, ensuring rapid reset of the internal node N0.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical biasing currents required for GHz bandwidth in 130nm.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC bandwidth, transient tracking delay, and reset time of the burst-mode receiver buffer.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Burst-Mode Receiver Buffer
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm5_prime=5u L_xm5_prime=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

* DUT
XM5 VDD N0 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 RESET GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM1 N3 IN N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 N4 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM2 N4 N1 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM5_PRIME VDD N0 OUT GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5_prime} w={W_xm5_prime}
XM3 N3 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Missing connections and biasing
R_short N4 N0 1m
I_tail N5 GND 200u
I_load1 N1 GND 50u
R_load OUT GND 10k
C_load OUT GND 250f

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0.6 1.2 1n 0.1n 0.1n 4n 10n)
VRESET RESET 0 PULSE(0 1.8 7n 0.1n 0.1n 1n 10n)

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 50 1Meg 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(OUT)
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=-3 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 10p 10n
  meas tran delay_rise trig v(IN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran delay_fall trig v(IN) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran reset_time trig v(RESET) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.2 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
